dialogue_texts: I'm still standing, and I'm still waiting for an answer. That's what counts.
You have a tenacity that is as annoying as it is effective, shrine maiden.
Very well. My daughter isn't missing in the way you fear.
Then quit playing coy. If she isn't lost, then where is she?
She is currently in no man's land, where the barrier is thinnest.
She's trying to understand why you rubbed the curse of glohm off some maid.
I was just trying to ask for help, but fine...
If she's at the boundary, I'm heading there right now.
At the very edge of the world, she isn't just looking for answers.
Even after I've dealt with Berenice, my plots against the Order aren't over.
You shouldn't celebrate too early because the wounded Berenice is calling for help.
